story.heading: Why I Made Manifest More Money
paragraphs: Hey, my name is Sean Ali. I kept seeing the same problem: useful ideas about money, mindset, and manifestation were buried inside giant books and complicated routines.
This is the shorter version. You get a set of practical controls you can test: clarify the target, rehearse the process, notice opportunity, make the ask, and take the next grounded move.

faq.question: Do I need to do all 20 hacks?
faq.answer: No. Pick one that fits what you need right now. Try it. Notice whether it changes your clarity, attention, or behavior. Keep the useful ones.

faq.question: Is this saying manifestation guarantees money?
faq.answer: No. Some practices come from classic manifestation traditions; others come from goal-setting, planning, and behavioral methods. None guarantees income or external outcomes.

faq.question: How do I receive it?
faq.answer: After the verified Whop checkout is connected, buyers receive immediate gated access to the approved PDF and a simple first-use page.

faq.question: Can I read it on my phone?
faq.answer: Yes. The approved PDF is designed with large typography, one hack per page, and very little dense text.

finalClose.heading: Open the Pack. Pick One Hack. Make the Move.
finalClose.description: Use the page that matches your current goal, then connect the practice to one real action. Keep what helps.
